rules.title: Bridge Stamping Curved Profile Requirement
rules.description: When creating bridge stamping, must use curved/arched profile for proper forming
rules.rule: Bridge stamping must create curved connecting profile using arc geometry
rules.error_message: ERROR: Bridge stamping must create curved connecting profile (hình cong nối). Use arched profile with ArcOfCircle geometry.

implementation_requirements.profile_description: Create arched profile using three points: start, middle (depth), end

example_fail.description: Bridge stamping with flat rectangular profile
